sources.title: Cholesterol and the Safety Factor for Neuromuscular Transmission
key_facts_used: Safety factor = EPP amplitude / AP threshold = 2-5
nAChR density ~10,000/μm² at postsynaptic crests

MEPP amplitude ~0.5-1 mV
40 mol% cholesterol in synaptic vesicles

sources.title: Neuromuscular Junction Transmission Failure in Aging and Sarcopenia
key_facts_used: NMJ ~30 μm long in mammals
Synaptic cleft 50-100 nm wide
Junctional folds increase postsynaptic area 8-fold
AChR density ~10,000/μm² (consistent with Krivoi)
Human NMJ safety factor ~2x threshold
Aging: fold simplification, Nav1.4 redistribution, reduced vesicle count
Type II (fast) fibers age faster
